newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends easier vs dlr at 185.34/39.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends easier vs dlr at 185.34/39.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed easier against the dollar on Tuesday but was steady against the central bank's currency basket, traders said.
The Hungarian currency ended at 185.34/39 to the dollar, compared with 185.14/19 at the opening.
After hectic morning trading, the Hungarian inter-bank forex market had a routine afternoon session, traders added.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
